question: What static page behavior can be recovered from real decoded text?
evidence_type: observed source bytes; derived control-flow explanation
conclusion: ID14552 defines an incognito-blocked page. On load it reads loadTimeData.missingExtensions; a nonempty list unhides the missing-extensions container, appends entries as text nodes and returns. Otherwise it unhides the blocking-extensions container and populates loadTimeData.blockingExtensions. ID14565 is an incognito page template: it subscribes to theme-changed, applies hasCustomBackground, reloads chrome://theme/css/incognito_tab_theme.css with a timestamp and sends observeThemeChanges. It contains actual chrome://resources CSS/JS imports. These paths are embedded references, not numeric-ID filenames.
unknowns: Arc entry point, backend message implementation, supplied values, active flags and rendered behavior were not observed.
